verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is an online government service, so asking whether it offers official SDKs is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no mention of any SDK, API, or developer tooling. The probes show only a script-only application shell at the root and a 404 on the long-published entry path, neither of which bears on SDK availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
